# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 20 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale: Records Broken Across Multiple Flat Types

- **New national record for 2-room HDB resale — Queenstown unit sells for S$696,000** - A high-floor 2-room flat at SkyParc @ Dawson in Queenstown changed hands for S$696,000 on 15 July 2026, setting a new national resale record for the flat type. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/2-room-national-record-broken-as-queenstown-unit-sells-for-s696000/)

- **4-room flat in Geylang district hits new price record at S$1.1 million** - A unit at 82B Circuit Road (MacPherson Spring) sold for S$1.1 million in July 2026, beating the previous Geylang district high by S$12,000 despite being on a lower floor. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/4-room-hdb-flat-set-a-new-geylang-price-record-at-1-1m/)

- **Tampines GreenVerge records first 3-room resale at S$628,000 after MOP** - The newly MOP-ed Tampines GreenVerge project saw its first 3-room resale transaction at S$628,000 on 14 July 2026, entering the market one month after an executive flat in the same town sold for S$1.24 million. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/first-3-room-resale-at-this-newly-mop-ed-tampines-project-fetches-s628000/)

## HDB Policy & New Developments

- **Singapore lowers qualifying age for senior-friendly public housing** - The qualifying age for senior-friendly public housing has been reduced, a policy change that could encourage older residents to downsize and free up larger HDB flats in the broader market. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapore-just-lowered-the-age-for-senior-friendly-public-housing-a-move-that-could-free-up-larger-hdb-flats/)

- **Gillman Barracks to become a new residential neighbourhood with heritage and greenery retained** - The historic Gillman Barracks site is planned for redevelopment into a mixed public and private residential neighbourhood, with 25 heritage buildings and 8 hectares of greenery to be preserved. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/gillman-barracks-housing-estate/)

## Private Homes & Rental Market

- **New private home sales drop to 2-year low in June, July rebound expected** - Developers sold just 156 private homes (excluding ECs) in June 2026, the lowest figure in two years, with the mid-year school holiday period cited as amplifying the usual seasonal slowdown. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/developers-new-home-sales-fall-to-a-2-year-low-in-june-rebound-expected-in-july/)

- **Condo and HDB rental market rebounds in June after quieter May** - Both condo and HDB rents edged higher in June 2026 and transaction volumes picked up broadly, according to the 99-SRX Rental Flash Report. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-hdb-rental-market-rebound-june-2026/)
